title: Andy Reid says Patrick Mahomes in 'good position' to get on field at Chiefs OTAs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Andy Reid says Patrick Mahomes in 'good position' to get on field at Chiefs OTAs
sources.description: Patrick Mahomes is recovering from a torn ACL and LCL he suffered in Week 15 of the 2026 NFL season. Andy Reid provided an update on the QB's rehab.
